thread:
Priya (PM): Heads-up — we need better visibility into why requests are routed to different model variants across tiers/regions. Customers keep asking why their Enterprise traffic fell back to quantized-variant. quick sync?
Nikhil: +1. Current logs only show final model id, not the decision path. We should emit a compact routing header and a trace-level decision blob.
Sam: For headers I'm thinking something like: `X-RW-Routing: tier=enterprise;region=eu-west-1;decision=variant_4;reason=capacity_fallback`
Diego: That header looks fine. Also want metrics: count(decision=capacity_fallback, by=tier, region, model_variant) and latency histograms per decision.
Olivia: UX idea — on the request trace panel show a "Decision breakdown" timeline: routing policy hit -> quota check -> capacity -> fallback -> final inference. Each step links to the raw logs/headers.
Priya (PM): Nice. How do we keep trace size/payload reasonable? we can't always attach full policy json.
Nikhil: Attach only a decision summary in trace: step name + short reason + rule id. Full policy can be fetched by rule id from console if needed. Example summary payload: `{rule_id:r-324, step:quota, result:over, override:false}`
routing-bot: deploy-bot posted a trace sample: `trace_id=trc_2026_09_21_001, hdr=X-RW-Routing:tier=free;region=us-east-1;decision=variant_q4;reason=quota`
Sam: We should also show which model variant was used as fallback (quantized / smaller / region-local) and estimated cost delta vs nominal. Product wants to show "cost impact" per fallback in the UI.
Diego: Telemetry-wise, add an alert when fallback rate for a tier > 2% sustained for 10m. Also track per-route SLO degradation (p50/p95 increase) correlated with fallback spikes.
Olivia: For rollout UX: when doing canary we should surface routing decision distribution in the rollout panel (e.g., 70% -> variant A, 30% -> variant B) and allow click-through to traces that show why a request hit B.
Priya (PM): Agree. Also need role-level access — support can see trace summaries but not full customer PII/logs. Keep PII out of headers.
Nikhil: Implementation note: add a compact header `X-RW-Decision` + a trace attribute `rw.routing.decisions` as a small JSON array (max 1KB) for internal traces.
Sam: Quick query example to find fallbacks in logs: ```
json_extract(headers, '$.X-RW-Routing') LIKE '%reason=capacity_fallback%'
```
Diego: UX request — add a sampled list on the per-route dashboard showing "recent fallback examples" (links to traces) with anonymized payloads. Sampling rate configurable.
Olivia: I'll mock the Decision breakdown panel UI tomorrow and post a screenshot. :eyes:
Priya (PM): Action items: Nikhil + Sam prototype header + metrics this week, Diego add alert proposal, Olivia mock UI. We'll review Fri. Thanks! :+1:
Sam: sg. I'll start a small RFC with header names and example traces.
Nikhil: I'll add a tiny instrumentation patch to emit the `rw.routing.decisions` attr behind a feature flag.
routing-bot: note: feature-flag "routing-trace-summary" enabled in staging.
Priya (PM): perfect — we'll use staging traces for the UI mock.
Olivia: thx team!
